mealPlan.name: Creamy Garlic Chicken & Mushroom Pasta
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions until al dente. Reserve 1/2 cup of pasta water, then drain and set aside.

While pasta cooks, season chicken breasts with salt and pepper. In a large skillet over medium-high heat, add 1 tablespoon olive oil. Add chicken and cook for 5-7 minutes per side, or until golden brown and cooked through. Remove chicken from skillet and set aside to rest, then slice into bite-sized pieces.

In the same skillet, add the remaining 1 tablespoon olive oil. Add sliced mushrooms and cook for 5-7 minutes until softened and browned. Add minced garlic and chopped onion, cook for another 2-3 minutes until fragrant.

Pour in the chicken broth and bring to a simmer, scraping up any browned bits from the bottom of the pan. Stir in the heavy cream and grated Parmesan cheese. Reduce heat to low and simmer for 5 minutes, allowing the sauce to thicken slightly.
Add the cooked pasta and sliced chicken back into the skillet with the sauce. Toss to combine, adding a splash of the reserved pasta water if needed to reach desired consistency.
Stir in fresh chopped parsley. Taste and adjust seasoning with salt and pepper as needed.
Serve hot, garnished with extra Parmesan cheese if desired.
tips: For an even richer sauce, add a tablespoon of cream cheese along with the heavy cream.
To save time, use pre-sliced mushrooms and pre-minced garlic.

Leftovers can be stored in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 3 days. Reheat gently on the stovetop or microwave, adding a splash of milk or broth if the sauce has thickened too much.
